title: Marketplace Traffic Defence Lab
algorithm: Trusted baseline P99 → bounded candidate grid → labelled replay → observation proposal
engine: Python standard library; no ML, CrowdSec or external recommendation service

budgets.meaning: Explicit lab design constraints, not measured production capacity.

observations.meaning: Descriptive evidence only; these features do not label an actor as malicious.

edge_proposal.reason: 1.5 times the trusted per-source-minute P99; shared-network fixture included.

proposals.rollback: Revert if legitimate scenario rejection exceeds 1%; production buyer budget is not established.
limitations: Synthetic labels do not establish production precision or conversion impact.
A separate synthetic holdout is evaluated; real traffic review is required before enforcement.
Slow abuse, rotating identities and distributed sources remain residual risks.
WAF trailing-window behaviour is not reproduced by this token-bucket replay.
Shared JA4 values are investigation context and never a blocking condition.
